content.title: Muslims Day Is Now Even Better!
content.subtitle: Do You Know What’s New?
content.body:
What’s New in Muslims Day to Make Your Deen Easier

To make your daily worship easier, more organized, and consistent, several new features and improvements have been added in Muslims Day versions 6.2.1 and 6.2.2. The new features are already available in your app. Have you tried them all?

Salah Times and Tracking from Home

Now you can see all 5 daily Salah times on the homepage and easily track which Salahs you have performed. Reviewing your daily Salah consistency is now easier.

Make Your Time with the Quran Better

The Quran Experience has been improved. Tilawat, Tafsir, Search, Bookmark, and other essential options are now better organized. Some Quran Tilawat issues have also been fixed in version 6.2.2.

Muslims Day, Your Umrah Companion

The new Umrah Tracker helps you track important steps of Umrah and complete your journey in a more organized way.

More New Features

Home Screen Widget is now more enriched. Essential Widgets are free for everyone, while Premium users can enjoy additional special Widgets. Premium users also get Auto-Silent, which automatically silences the phone during Salah times.

Muslims Day now supports Arabic and Indonesian language alongside Bangla and English.

Haven’t Forgotten Durud & Istigfar, Have You?

We often forget small but valuable acts of worship in our busy days. The new Istigfar Reminder lets you set reminders at your preferred time, helping you continue Istighfar even when busy.

Have You Tried All the New Features?

Set the Istigfar Reminder? Explored the Umrah Tracker? Tried the new Home Screen Widget?

Our goal behind every new feature is simple: Muslims Day should not be just another app on your phone, but a companion in every small effort of your Deeni life, from Salah and Quran to Dhikr and daily Ibadah.

Explore the New Features Today from "Tools" page.

footer_button.hint: Update the latest version 6.2.2 (if already not updated yet)
